limitations: Native manufacturer source shapes are preserved at unit scale, including original mechanical standoffs and headers; simplified colors do not identify IC packages or establish measured optical appearance.

Original exterior dimensions constrain this hollow reference.1mm wall and1mm front/back caps are declared estimates, not measured internalCAD. Exact fasteners, ribs, connector pockets and fit remain UNKNOWN; optical aperture is a real through-hole.

The native STEP is the bare reference assembly; the product includes a case. Native electronics remain unscaled inside the dimension-constrained hollow enclosure.7mm body and5.7mm optical corner radii are approximate photo-derived visualization parameters, not manufacturer measurements.

V1 SH8601/FT3168 and V2 CO5300/CST820 share documented outside dimensions, but current V2 internal source-CAD correspondence is UNKNOWN. Original V1 rear branding is retained only as a reference photo and is not mapped as V2 branding.
Case key caps, USB/TF/speaker apertures, battery installation and internal ribs remain UNKNOWN; public2D BOOT/POWER controls expose real digital inputs without invented3D key geometry.
SKU29957 includes a3.7V MX1.25 battery. Its capacity, dimensions, label and internal mounting have not been independently sourced; no fabricated battery solid is included.
